    name=mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_JOINT,i)
    typ=int(m.jnt_type[i]); tname={0:"free",1:"ball",2:"slide",3:"hinge"}[typ]
    axis=[round(x,3) for x in m.jnt_axis[i].tolist()]
    lim=[round(x,4) for x in m.jnt_range[i].tolist()] if m.jnt_limited[i] else [None,None]
    joints.append({"name":name,"type":tname,"axis":axis,"ctrlrange":lim})
